rows.name: size
rows.description: contains the size value of the Accordion.

rows.name: disabled
rows.description: controls whether the Accordion is expanded or collapsed.

rows.name: onToggle
rows.description: Toggle will also be able to be handled outside the component using this function.

rows.name: headerText
rows.description: contains the content of the header. The value can either be text or JSX.

rows.name: headingElement
rows.description: the heading element that will be used for the Accordion Header. As described in w3.org, accordion header trigger is wrapped in an element with role heading that is appropriate for the information architecture of the page. There is no visual impact. Please update this to fit the content of your page.

rows.name: expanded
rows.description: controls whether the Accordion is expanded or collapsed.

rows.name: contentSlot
rows.type: contains the type of content in the dropdown. The value can either be text or slot. Suggested Preferred Content: ODSTextBody | ODSTextBody
